description: Full detail for one event by id, including the inbound headers and body that anyhook_events omits, plus the destination's response. Payloads can be large and often contain personal data, so fetch one at a time, only when the body is needed. Account or local store.

api_key.description: API key (ahk_live_...) from anyhook_quickstart. Only needed over HTTP when no Authorization header is set; ignored over stdio.

name: anyhook_inspect
title: Inspect a specific event
